title: GS1 WebOntology Registry Manifest
description: Catalog of every sector/domain/artifact combination published in this repository. GitHub Pages cannot be directory-listed, so this file is the single discoverable index the SPA (and any other consumer) relies on to find JSON-LD/TTL/SHACL files, their versions and their lifecycle status. Publish it at registry/manifest.jsonld and regenerate it as part of your release CI job, alongside a registry/manifest.schema.json copy of this file.

sectorCode.description: One of the Gs1Sector codeValue values, e.g. TRAN, MANU. Omit entirely for cross-sector domains published under a 'shared' location rather than under a specific sector — the SPA groups these under a separate 'Cross-Sector' section instead of a Gs1Sector.

url.description: Stable public identifier under the resolver host (e.g. https://gs1-epcis-reg.org/...). This is what other JSON-LD files' @context/@id point at, what the UI links to, and what RDF content negotiation redirects to. It does not need to correspond to any real file path on any host.

source.description: Actual physical location the bytes are fetched from today, typically a GitHub Pages URL (e.g. https://gs1-switzerland.github.io/WebOntology/rail/voc/data/gs1RailVoc.jsonld). The SPA fetches this directly; the resolver Function 303-redirects requests for 'url' here.
